themes: The Quran is easy to remember
summary_for_children: Al-Qamar means The Moon. It tells of the moon splitting and of Nuh, 'Ad, Thamud, Lut and Pharaoh, and repeats that Allah made the Quran easy to remember.
world_title: Moon Split and the Easy Reminder
environment_concept: A full moon over the plain (54:1; the splitting itself is not pictured), pouring rain (54:11), springs bursting from the earth (54:12), a vessel of planks being built (54:13) and palms uprooted by the wind (54:20).
architecture_and_scenery: Night sky, a flood plain with a vessel of planks and nails, uprooted palms, a rocky valley with a she-camel's trail.

palette.lighting: Night with a pale moon, storm light

areas.description: A vessel of planks and nails.
